note: RECORDED SAMPLE written by the course authors in the shape of a headless claude -p envelope. It is not a live model result.

structured_output.summary: The quick-redeem change hard-codes a live-looking key, logs the customer email, computes points with a float and adds no test.

findings.title: Hard-coded API key in source
findings.evidence: REDEEM_API_KEY is assigned a bb_live_ literal in config.py.
findings.fix: Read the key from an environment variable with os.environ.get and rotate the exposed value.

findings.title: Customer email written to the log
findings.evidence: logging.info prints the email address of the customer.
findings.fix: Log the customer id only, for example log_event("redeem", customer_id, points=cost).

findings.title: Points computed with a float
findings.evidence: drinks * 100 * 0.9 produces a float and the ledger would store fractional points.
findings.fix: Use integer math, for example cost = drinks * 100 and apply any discount with integer division.

findings.title: New function has no test
findings.evidence: quick_redeem is added and nothing under tests/ changes.
findings.fix: Add tests for the cost, the balance check and a bad request.
